# Generated speech audio

**Generated directory.** Do not edit files here by hand.

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `manifest.json` | Clip ID → Opus path map for `AudioManager` |
| `phase1/*.opus` | Mono 48 kHz Opus clips (when generated) |

## Command

```bash
npm run tts
npm run tts:validate
```

Dry-run inventory only: `npm run tts:dry`.
